local-jsonl.durability_ceiling: local JSONL only with durable hash-chain, CloudEvents source/id replay rejection, and prepared-effect idempotency key reservation; signed terminal effect transition chains, outbox claims, relay/reconciliation reports, handle-bound adapter registry resolution, and asymmetric sender-bound service ingress are sqlite-wal only and this backend is not distributed or tamper-proof.

sqlite-wal.durability_ceiling: local SQLite/WAL reservation, outbox, and relay evidence only; rev0641 service-bound ingress verifies an asymmetric request-bound sender RS256 signature before reservation, but it is not a deployed HTTP service, DPoP verifier, TLS terminator, nonce/replay-cache authority, or distributed exactly-once protocol
sqlite-wal.effect_outbox_status: Schema v10 creates one effect_outbox row in the same SQLite transaction as each prepared ledger entry, permits one local worker to claim reserved work as inflight under a bounded lease, permits stale-lease reclaim, and terminally updates the same row only inside a signed transition transaction.
sqlite-wal.effect_relay_known_limit: the handle-bound adapter still targets a deterministic local SQLite downstream journal and a local JSON registry; it prevents request-shaped selection of adapter/signer/trust/downstream fields but is not yet a signed control plane, real external service adapter, transport authentication boundary, or HSM-backed signer.
sqlite-wal.restore_ceiling: v36 local snapshot restore verifies the replay ledger/outbox/claim state only; external downstream journals, relay registries, ingress operator profiles, and service caller public-key configs remain operator-managed evidence and are not folded into ledger snapshot restore evidence.

blocked_claim: Capability manifest is package-local evidence. Rev0641 narrows the service ingress boundary by replacing service-owned symmetric caller secrets with a service-pinned caller public JWK and request-bound RS256 proof, but it is still not a deployed HTTP service, TLS terminator, DPoP verifier, HSM custody proof, signed control plane, remote delivery proof, or distributed exactly-once guarantee.

The cube still does not prove external delivery or distributed exactly-once effects.

read-only snapshot verification still verifies schema v10 outbox and claim metadata; rev0635/rev0636 relay downstream stores, rev0637 relay registries, and rev0641 ingress service caller bindings and operator profiles are external operator-managed files and are not embedded in SQLite snapshot restore evidence.

snapshot restore minimum capability for sqlite-wal is v36 so restored ledgers cannot silently lose the relay/reconciliation expectations introduced in rev0635, configured relay adapter boundary introduced in rev0636, handle-bound relay registry introduced in rev0637, or profile-bound ingress reservation command introduced in rev0639.
security_note: Rev0641 replaces the rev0641 symmetric sender HMAC with an asymmetric RS256 sender-possession signature over length-framed request/service/profile/principal/case material. The service config pins only a caller public JWK and rejects symmetric caller secrets. This is still not full DPoP, TLS client certificate binding, nonce/replay-cache policy, or a deployed gateway.
validation_notes: rev0641 package validation requires CTest plus tools/validate_rev0641_ingress_sender_rs256.py against the exact packaged binary and manifest.
